**mass action** $\longrightarrow$

$$\frac{dx}{dt} = \frac{\alpha x^2}{1 + (1+\sigma_1)x^2 + \sigma_2 x^4} - \gamma x + 1$$

$\sigma_1 = \frac{K_3}{K_2}$

$\sigma_2 = \frac{K_4}{K_2}$  
relative binding constants

$\alpha = \frac{n k_t p_0 d_T}{r} \sim \text{synthesis/basal rate}$

$\gamma = \frac{k_d}{r \sqrt{K_1 K_2}} \sim \text{degradation/basal rate}$
